QUOTE: Its `_mutexed` variants take the library mutex when `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` is on.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says that `_mutexed` variants take the mutex when threading is on. It never says that `mbedtls_memory_buffer_alloc_init()` installs a mutexed pair or a plain pair of calloc/free functions, chosen at compile time inside the init function.
